_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); beverage and convenient-food signals

pit_profile.why: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food and beverage company with a complementary portfolio of brands, including Frito-Lay, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Quaker and Tropicana'; 'Our beverage, food and snack products are in highly competitive categories and markets', 'In 2020, we and The Coca-Cola Company represented approximately 22% and 20%, respectively, of the U.S. liquid refreshment beverage category by estimated retail sales in measured channels', and 'However, The Coca-Cola Company has significant carbonated soft drink (CSD) share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2020 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: PepsiCo's own FY2020 10-K says 'Our business can be adversely affected if e-commerce channels and hard discounters take significant additional market share away from traditional retailers or we fail to find ways to create more powerful digital tools and capabilities for our retail customers to enable them to grow their businesses.' At the same time it sells through e-commerce itself: 'Our products are also available and sold directly to consumers on a growing number of company-owned and third-party e-commerce websites and mobile commerce applications.'. The stock trades at 28.9x FY21E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ECOMMERCE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing the shift away from physical retail into PepsiCo's own sales specifically.

classification.quality_note: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food and beverage company with a complementary portfolio of brands, including Frito-Lay, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Quaker and Tropicana'; 'Our beverage, food and snack products are in highly competitive categories and markets', 'In 2020, we and The Coca-Cola Company represented approximately 22% and 20%, respectively, of the U.S. liquid refreshment beverage category by estimated retail sales in measured channels', and 'However, The Coca-Cola Company has significant carbonated soft drink (CSD) share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2020 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 10.03x; +44% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.81; conservative 2yr -3%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -40.8%/yr (worst year FY11-FY20, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +8.8%/yr (Q1 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +8.8%/yr (FY11-FY20 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +41.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY20); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PEP (retrospective, 2021-05-28) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 10.03x (81.7% downside to Bear $27 / +8.2% upside to Bull $160) | Adj composite 2.30 vs market 3.11: gap -0.81 [OVERVALUED] | +44% above the EPP floor $102 (20x FY21E $5.12) | Conservative 2-yr case: -3.4% total (-1.7%/yr) | At 28.9x FY21E the 15% hurdle price $196 sits above the BULL case; servings not reported for Q1 2021, forward revenues +7.3% (Q1 2021 net revenue ex-currency); e-commerce is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
